newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras maintained as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras maintained as buy.

text.p: -- Banco Omega said it is maintaining its buy recommendation on shares of Brazilian state-owned telecommunications giant Telebras.
-- The bank cited company preparations for greater competition following the telecommunications sector's privatization.
-- It added: "Our projections for 1996 and 1997 indicate increasing results, supported by a still strongly restrained demand in the sector," the bank said in a research report.
-- Omega projects a consolidated net profit for Telebras at $2.8 billion in 1996 and $3.61 billion in 1997.
-- Telebras' preferred closed down 1.48 percent at 76.55 reais while its voting common dropped 1.07 percent to end at 64.70 reais Tuesday on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange.
